description: The image is a landscape photograph depicting a prominent, largely barren conical mountain with a flattened top, under a blue sky with scattered white clouds. The mountain's surface appears rocky and grey-brown. In the foreground, the terrain is covered with low-lying vegetation in shades of brown and reddish-green, characteristic of heathland or tundra, interspersed with patches of snow and scattered light-coloured rocks. The image caption identifies it as "Bare rocks and rock debris (Sweden)" and attributes the credit to K. Larsson. This photograph illustrates the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) land cover category for "Bare rocks, outcrops, cliffs and scree," which defines areas of bedrock outcrops with minimal high vegetation.
